title: Atomic Structure & EM Radiation
blurb: SI units, energy, the Bohr atom, shells and binding energy, ionisation and excitation, and the electromagnetic spectrum.

diagrams.title: The Bohr atom
diagrams.blurb: Shells, binding energy, and tap-to-trigger excitation and ionisation.

title: Electricity & X-ray Circuits
blurb: Charge, potential difference, current and resistance; transformers, rectification and the primary, secondary and filament circuits.

diagrams.title: The transformer
diagrams.blurb: Change the turns ratio and the primary voltage, and see the voltage and current on the secondary side.

diagrams.title: Rectification
diagrams.blurb: Turn AC into the one-way voltage the tube needs, from half-wave to high-frequency, and compare the ripple.

title: X-ray Production & the X-ray Tube
blurb: The parts of the tube, thermionic emission, what happens in the anode, Bremsstrahlung and characteristic radiation, and the X-ray spectrum.

diagrams.title: The rotating-anode tube
diagrams.blurb: Step through an exposure, or tap a numbered part to see what it does.

diagrams.title: The X-ray spectrum
diagrams.blurb: Change target, generator, kVp, mA and filtration and watch the spectrum, its quantity and its quality respond.

diagrams.title: Electron–target interactions
diagrams.blurb: The four things that can happen when an electron reaches a tungsten atom: excitation, outer and inner ionisation, and braking, with the Auger alternative.

title: Effects of Radiation
blurb: Ionisation in cells, stochastic and deterministic effects, risk versus benefit, and ALARP.

diagrams.title: Stochastic or deterministic?
diagrams.blurb: Sort effects and properties into stochastic and deterministic, with an explanation for each.

diagrams.title: Inside the cell
diagrams.blurb: Follow one X-ray photon from ionisation to free radicals and DNA damage, then fire a thousand and see how chance decides the outcome.

diagrams.title: May or will? Dose and response
diagrams.blurb: Predict, then see, how the chance and severity of stochastic and deterministic effects change with dose.

diagrams.title: One in a million
diagrams.blurb: Give a population the same dose and see how many radiation-induced cancers to expect, and why nobody can say who.

diagrams.title: Which tissues matter most?
diagrams.blurb: Explore tissue weighting factors on a cartoon body, put an area in the beam, and rank the organs.

diagrams.title: Justify it?
diagrams.blurb: Eight imaging requests: go ahead, suggest another test, no imaging, or get more information first?

diagrams.title: What can we do?
diagrams.blurb: Make the choices for an AP pelvis and watch the dose move, then sort what affects dose by who controls it.

title: Interactions with Matter
blurb: Transmission, absorption and scatter; the photoelectric effect, Compton and coherent scatter; attenuation and absorption edges.

diagrams.title: Interactions and attenuation
diagrams.blurb: The photoelectric effect beside Compton or coherent scatter, and an attenuation graph with the K-edges of iodine and lead.

title: Digital Image Formation
blurb: CR and DR detectors, digitisation, histograms and look-up tables, windowing, and image quality measures.

diagrams.title: Window level and width
diagrams.blurb: Change the window level and width and watch the image, its histogram and the look-up table respond.

diagrams.title: CR and DR detectors
diagrams.blurb: Follow an X-ray photon to a pixel value in CR, indirect DR and direct DR, and see how far the signal spreads.

title: Exposure & Image Quality
blurb: kVp and mAs, contrast, density, noise and resolution, focal spot, grids, AEC and the exposure index.

diagrams.title: The exposure console
diagrams.blurb: Set the exposure and see brightness, contrast, noise, sharpness, exposure index and dose change. Then try the "What do I do?" scenarios and "Higher or lower?".

diagrams.title: Focal spot and geometry
diagrams.blurb: Change the focal spot, ORD and FRD and watch the penumbra and magnification of the shadow.

title: Dosimetry & Dose Control
blurb: Absorbed, equivalent and effective dose, ESD and DAP, DRLs, dosimeters and controlling dose.

diagrams.title: The dose ladder
diagrams.blurb: Typical effective doses as time of natural background radiation and lifetime risk, with a way of explaining each one to a patient.

title: Radiation Protection & Legislation
blurb: IR(ME)R 2017, IRR17, ALARP, time, distance and shielding, the inverse square law, consent and record keeping.

diagrams.title: The inverse square law
diagrams.blurb: Watch a beam spread over a larger area as distance increases.

title: Radioactivity
blurb: Nuclear stability, isotopes, alpha, beta and gamma decay, half-life and technetium-99m.

diagrams.title: Half-life
diagrams.blurb: Watch a sample of nuclei decay at random, and see the number left halve with each half-life.

diagrams.title: Decay builder
diagrams.blurb: Work out the daughter nucleus for alpha, beta-minus, beta-plus, electron capture and gamma decay.

title: QA & QC
blurb: Quality assurance and control, IPEM Report 91, and the routine tests with their remedial and suspension levels.

diagrams.title: QA checker
diagrams.blurb: Set a test result and see whether it is within tolerance, at the remedial level or at the suspension level; then test yourself.
